review_status: A07 reviewed evidence; G3 released after verification on merged main 3845f42d983e6f741b47bf212c227f26b12efc9d.
approval_meaning: These sanitized summaries are the approved A07 measurement values for later paper drafting. They do not establish production Kerberos behavior, a new vulnerability, NTP compromise, power-loss durability, or exactly-once response recovery.

configuration.trial_order: trial-major; selected scenarios run in scenario order for each trial
configuration.request_timing: time.perf_counter_ns around one loopback HTTP request
configuration.startup_timing: from subprocess.Popen return until the first healthy endpoint response

reviewed_findings.functional_smoke: 46 expected attempts across E01-E10 completed with zero failed attempts; E04 reports one expected, one observed and zero missing attempt for each mutation phase.

limitations: E04-E10 are represented by a one-trial smoke run; only E01-E03 have 30 repeated trials.
The no-cache mode is intentionally incomplete and is a local comparison control, not a claim about standard Kerberos deployments.
Time categories are derived by the runner from declared validation rules; the public service response does not disclose an internal failure reason.
Fixed mode order, cold process starts and mixed E02 accept/reject responses mean latency values are descriptive local measurements, not a causal speedup or throughput claim.

Ordinary local process restart and SQLite retention are tested; machine crash, power loss, hostile rollback, distributed replay coordination and exactly-once response recovery are outside this evidence.
